source_refs.note: Exercise 13.1, Question 11 (book page 248, PDF 253); answer key PDF 310-311. Key's -2 ft/sec is wrong; correct 0 ft/sec.

blocks.prompt: 11 A stone is thrown upwards and its height after \(t\) seconds is given by: \(s(t) = -16t^2 + 32t + 10\) (in feet). Find the instantaneous velocity at \(t = 1\).
blocks.explanation:
Patthar ooper phenka gaya hai aur \(s(t)\) us ki height batata hai. Humein \(t = 1\) second par us ki instantaneous velocity chahiye, yani \(s'(1)\).
Plan: \(t = 1\) par first principle: \(s(1 + \delta t)\) kholein, \(s(1)\) minus, \(\delta t\) se divide, limit. Aakhir mein jawab ka matlab bhi samjhenge, kyunke yahan jawab bohat dilchasp hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(s(t) = -16t^2 + 32t + 10\) ft, \(t_1 = 1\) s.
Find karna hai: \(v(1) = s'(1)\).
Tareeqa: kisi lamhe \(t = t_1\) par instantaneous velocity (usi lamhe ki raftaar) derivative hai: \(v(t_1) = \lim_{\delta t \to 0} \frac{s(t_1 + \delta t) - s(t_1)}{\delta t}\) (Section 13.2.1). Matlab: bohat chhote time interval ki average velocity, jab woh interval zero ki taraf jaye. Exercise 13.1 mein hum yeh limit khud nikalte hain.

\(s(1)\) aur \(s(1 + \delta t)\) nikalein
\[s(1) = -16 + 32 + 10 = 26\]
\[s(1 + \delta t) = -16(1 + \delta t)^2 + 32(1 + \delta t) + 10\]
\[= -16 - 32\,\delta t - 16(\delta t)^2 + 32 + 32\,\delta t + 10\]
\[= 26 - 16(\delta t)^2\]
Kyun: \((1 + \delta t)^2\) khol kar \(-16\) se multiply kiya; minus sign har term par lagta hai. Phir \(-32\,\delta t\) aur \(+32\,\delta t\) aapas mein cancel ho gaye. Yehi cancel aage jawab ka raaz hai.

Minus karein aur \(\delta t\) se divide
\[s(1 + \delta t) - s(1) = -16(\delta t)^2\]
\[\dfrac{s(1 + \delta t) - s(1)}{\delta t} = -16\,\delta t\]
Kyun: \(26\) cancel hua aur ek \(\delta t\) divide se cancel hua; \(-16\,\delta t\) bacha.

Limit lein
\[v(1) = \lim_{\delta t \to 0}(-16\,\delta t) = 0\]
Kyun: \(\delta t = 0\) rakha to velocity \(0\) ft/sec aayi.

Jawab ka matlab
\[v(1) = 0,\quad s(1) = 26\ \text{ft}\]
Kyun: Velocity zero ka matlab hai patthar us lamhe ruk gaya. Ooper jaate hue raftaar kam hoti jati hai, sab se ooncha point (\(26\) ft) par ek lamhe ke liye zero hoti hai, phir patthar neeche girne lagta hai. Jaise gend ko seedha ooper phenkein to woh sab se ooncha ja kar pal bhar ruk jati hai.

Tasdeeq
\[s'(t) = -32t + 32\]
\[s'(1) = -32 + 32 = 0 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: General derivative \(-32t + 32\) mein \(t = 1\) rakha to bhi \(0\). Is liye \(-2\) ft/sec ghalat hai.
blocks.final_answer: \(v(1) = 0\) ft/sec (patthar apne sab se oonche point, \(26\) ft, par hai)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(-2\) ft/sec chhapti hai. Yeh ghalat hai: \(s'(t) = -32t + 32\), is liye \(s'(1) = 0\) ft/sec; patthar us lamhe sab se oonche point par ruka hua hai.
